title: Reproducing Kobayashi et al. 2017: interface states on SiC after an argon anneal

sample.note: The off-cut is recorded on the sample here; the stored measurements do not carry it.

sample.ours: DOPING: n_type_1e16 (recorded; no program reads it)

sample.paper: “in the range of 90-110 nm” for the whole set; no thickness per recipe
sample.note: Our SiC growth program has no test at 1150 °C for 20 h or at 1300 °C on this face, so the simulated thickness is outside its tested scope.

sample.paper: circular Al electrodes about 500 µm in diameter; no anneal after metal mentioned

history.note: The paper describes no clean, loading or ramp.

history.paper: “we first performed dry oxidation at either 1150°C for 20 h, or at 1300°C for 40 min or 1h 20 min”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 72000 TEMP 1150->1150 AMBIENT dry_O2

history.paper: “The diameter of circular Al electrodes was about 500 µm.” Deposition and any anneal after metal are not stated
“conventional high(1 MHz)-low method”; measurement temperature not stated
history.ours: the observable Dit at 0.3, 0.4 and 0.5 eV below the conduction band
history.note: The 1 MHz method misses fast states; the paper's Figure 4 shows more states with a 100 MHz reference.
